channel.title: The Oikos Journal
channel.description: Practical, encouraging writing on prayer, everyday evangelism, discipleship, and loving the people God has placed around you.

item.title: What Is an Oikos? The Biblical Meaning of Your Household
item.description: Oikos is the Greek word for household, but in the New Testament it means far more than the people under your roof. Here is what it meant then, and what it means for you now.

item.title: How to Pray for Unsaved Family and Friends (A Simple Daily Rhythm)
item.description: A five-minute daily rhythm for praying by name for the people you love who do not yet follow Jesus — including what to pray when it has been years.

item.title: Evangelism Without Being Weird: 12 Ways to Love Your Neighbour This Week
item.description: Twelve ordinary, non-awkward ways to move toward the people around you — the practical middle ground between praying for someone and preaching at them.

item.title: How to Share Your Testimony in Three Minutes
item.description: A simple three-part framework for telling your story of coming to faith — clearly, honestly, and short enough that people actually listen.

item.title: Oikos Evangelism: How the Early Church Actually Grew
item.description: The early Church grew from a few thousand to millions without buildings, budgets, or public platforms. Households were the engine — and the method still works.

item.title: Faith at Work: Your Coworkers Are Your Oikos
item.description: You spend more waking hours with colleagues than with almost anyone else. Here is how to be a genuine witness at work without becoming the person everyone avoids.

item.title: How to Invite Someone to Church Without It Being Awkward
item.description: Most people who come to faith were invited by someone they knew. Here is how to ask well, what to say, where to start, and what to do when the answer is no.

item.title: What to Actually Say When Someone Is Going Through Something Hard
item.description: Real sentences that help, the well-meant ones that hurt, and why showing up matters more than saying the right thing.

item.title: How to Disciple Someone When You Do Not Feel Qualified
item.description: You do not need a seminary degree to disciple someone — you need to be about a step ahead and willing to be honest. A simple, repeatable pattern anyone can use.

item.title: How to Pray for Your City (Without It Feeling Abstract)
item.description: Praying for a whole city can feel like praying for the weather. Here is how to make it specific, sustainable, and connected to the street you actually live on.

item.title: Plunder Hell, Populate Heaven: Your Part in Sending the Gospel
item.description: Your Oikos Map is your front line — but the Great Commission also needs people who send. A biblical call to go, pray and give, and an invitation to partner with Daniel and Katie Ziedins through e3 Canada.

item.title: From Hamilton's Streets to the Nations: What 12 Years of Saying Yes Has Built
item.description: How a weekly street outreach in Hamilton grew into Love on The World in 12 cities, Jesus Festival and SIX33 — and how you can partner with Daniel and Katie Ziedins through e3 Canada.

item.title: 23 Bible Verses to Pray Over Unsaved Family and Friends (With a Prayer for Each)
item.description: Scripture to pray for unsaved loved ones, grouped by what you are asking God for — open eyes, a soft heart, freedom, an open door — each with a short prayer you can say with their name in it.

item.title: How to Lead Someone to Jesus: A Simple, Honest Conversation Guide
item.description: How to tell when someone is open, explain the Gospel in four simple parts, pray with them without a script, and walk with a new believer through their first seven days.

item.title: What Is the Great Commission? Matthew 28:18–20 Explained for Everyday Believers
item.description: What the Great Commission says, what "make disciples of all nations" really means, why Jesus gave it to doubters, and how it starts with the people already around you.

item.title: What Is a Person of Peace? Luke 10 and Finding People Who Are Open to Jesus
item.description: The biblical meaning of a person of peace from Luke 10, how to recognise one, examples from Lydia to Zacchaeus, and how one open person can open a whole household.

item.title: How to Talk About Jesus With Family at Thanksgiving and Christmas
item.description: How to share your faith with family over the holidays without preaching or staying silent — gratitude questions, grace at the table, what to do when it gets tense, and hope for the only believer at the table.

item.title: Free Printable Oikos Map Template (PDF) — and How to Use It
item.description: Download a free two-page printable Oikos Map: circles for family, friends, work, school and neighbours, plus a five-person prayer and next-step plan — with ideas for churches, small groups and youth groups.

item.title: What Is Evangelism? A Simple Biblical Definition (and What It Is Not)
item.description: A clear, biblical definition of evangelism, what the good news actually is, what evangelism is not, the different forms it takes, and why it is meant for ordinary Christians.

item.title: How to Prayer Walk Your Neighbourhood: A Simple Guide
item.description: What prayer walking is, why it is biblical, what to pray for homes, schools and businesses as you pass, a 30-minute plan you can do this week, and how churches prayer walk together.

item.title: How to Start a Bible Study With Friends Who Do Not Believe (Yet)
item.description: How to invite curious friends to read the Bible together, a simple discovery-style format anyone can lead, eight passages to start with, and ground rules that keep it safe and honest.

item.title: 30 Spiritual Conversation Starters: Questions That Open Faith Conversations
item.description: Thirty genuine questions that open spiritual conversations naturally — from light to deep, about life, meaning, faith, Jesus and pain — plus how to follow up when someone answers.

item.title: Who Is My Neighbour? What Jesus Meant by "Love Your Neighbour"
item.description: What "love your neighbour as yourself" means in the Bible, how the Good Samaritan turns the question upside down, who your neighbour really is, and what loving them looks like this week.

item.title: How to Share Your Faith at School: A Guide for Christian Students
item.description: For high school and college students: how to live your faith at school, talk about Jesus naturally, invite friends, pray with other Christians and respond when people mock you.

item.title: 25 Bible Verses About Evangelism and Sharing Your Faith
item.description: Twenty-five Bible verses about evangelism, grouped by theme — the command, the message, why it matters, courage, gentleness, sowing and harvest — each with a one-line takeaway.

item.title: What Does the Bible Say About Hospitality? Opening Your Home to Your Oikos
item.description: What biblical hospitality means, how Jesus used the table, why hospitality is not entertaining, and simple ways to open your home to neighbours, coworkers and friends this month.

item.title: What Is Missional Living? How to Live on Mission in Everyday Life
item.description: What missional living means, where it comes from in Scripture, the five BELLS habits, and how to treat your street, workplace and third places as your mission field.

item.title: What Is a Disciple? The Biblical Meaning (and Six Marks of a Follower of Jesus)
item.description: What it means to be a disciple of Jesus, the six marks of a disciple in the Bible, how a disciple differs from simply believing, and how to start making disciples yourself.

item.title: How to Lead Your Child to Jesus: A Gentle Guide for Parents
item.description: How to explain the Gospel to a child simply, signs a child is ready to follow Jesus, a prayer they can pray, what to avoid, and how to grow a young disciple at home.

item.title: How to Answer 5 Common Objections to Christianity (With Gentleness and Respect)
item.description: Honest, gentle starting points for five common objections — suffering, other religions, hypocrites, being a good person, and trusting the Bible — and the posture that keeps the conversation open.

item.title: The Complete Guide to Oikos Evangelism: Pray, Care, Share, Disciple, Send
item.description: What oikos evangelism is, why it is how the Gospel has always spread, and a five-step rhythm for reaching the people already around you — with a practical guide for every step.

item.title: How to Start a Street Outreach Group in Your City
item.description: How to start a street outreach ministry with two or three believers: five steps, what an outreach night looks like, meeting practical needs, staying safe, and free coaching from Love on The World.

item.title: How to Follow Up After a Gospel Conversation
item.description: What to do in the first 48 hours after sharing the Gospel, how to respond to yes, not yet and no, simple messages you can send, and how to keep following up without being pushy.

item.title: What Is the Gospel? The Good News of Jesus in Plain Words
item.description: What the Gospel is in one sentence, the whole story in four movements, the key Bible verses, what the Gospel is not, how to respond — and a one-minute way to explain it to a friend.

item.title: How to Overcome Fear of Sharing Your Faith
item.description: The five fears most Christians feel about evangelism — rejection, not knowing what to say, ruining a friendship, looking weird, failing — what the Bible says to each, and small steps that build courage.

item.title: How to Share Your Faith Online and on Social Media
item.description: How to share your faith on social media without being preachy: what to post, how to handle comments and disagreement, moving to private conversations, and what to avoid.
